text: FCIteratedIntegral[f,x,a,b] is a special head indicating that the function \(f\) represents an iterated integral or a linear combination thereof and that it should be integrated in \(x\) from a to \(b\). This notation is understood by the function FCIteratedIntegralEvaluate that does the actual integration.
Notice that before applying FCIteratedIntegralEvaluate all rational functions of \(x\) in f should be converted to the FCPartialFractionFormrepresentation.
